title: Near-full blood did not prove a wounded dwarf would survive
claim: A planter accumulated physical injuries during an undead attack, returned indoors, and was later found dead while her recorded blood count was still 5904 of 5940. An earlier all-alive combat snapshot therefore did not establish survival after the encounter.
reproduction: Track damaged body parts, critical organ and airway injuries, consciousness, mobility, diagnosis and treatment in addition to blood. Reassess patients after combat and during recovery. Preserve uncertainty when a native death-cause record has not been inspected.
evidence: Firsthand AI-assisted Namemerchants observations on 2026-11-02; sanitized summaries of native state, not a published save or raw telemetry.
All 27 residents were alive after the four local attackers died.
At a later population stop, 26 remained alive and the native report identified the planter as found dead. Three injured arrivals had Rest jobs in the hospital.
limitations: One live fortress on Windows; relevant mods were not fully inventoried. Community reproduction is pending. The exact cause of death was not determined. Do not infer suffocation, bleeding, infection or successful treatment from these observations. A Rest job is not proof that diagnosis or treatment completed.
